verdict.rationale: Weaviate is described as an open-source vector database that can be deployed with Docker or Kubernetes, alongside a local embedding model, in addition to Weaviate Cloud. A community user independently confirms it is open source, easy to run locally, and can even run embedded in Python. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting and deployment documentation in the pack (only GitHub snippets), and some features such as natural-language answers and the Query Agent are Cloud-only.
